notes:
Everyone builds these grids with WebGL. including me, normally. So this morning I built a demo one in pure DOM instead. one matrix3d per card, from techniques I've been using for years. Infinite in every direction, domed, cursor lens, flashlight, click-to-open case study. Zero dependencies. Demo link (with claude skill) in comments

Designer: @jesper_alpacka. Curated on Collect UI (https://collectui.com).
